assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite animation sheet for the browser arcade game Space Attack. Style: polished retro 16-bit-like pixel illustration, crisp stair-step silhouettes, carefully shaded small pixel clusters, dark navy outlines, limited arcade palette, no photorealism, no 3D perspective. Actual transparent background. No text, grid lines, labels, shadows on the background, or watermark. Square sheet divided into EXACTLY two columns and two rows of equal square cells. One sprite centered at the exact center of each quadrant; generous transparent padding, every sprite fits entirely within its cell. Four successive animation frames read left to right then top to bottom. Keep the body anchored at the same center and scale in all frames, only animate the specified moving features. Viewed orthographically from directly above. Subject: a player spaceship facing UP, ivory hull with cyan and teal wing details, dark cockpit, swept wings and two orange engine flames at its bottom. Four-frame looping flicker of the orange thrusters, hull stays identical. Bold readable silhouette designed for about 48 pixels wide.
